d: Donald Trump’s Republican Party appears to be facing a major setback in the US midterm elections. Early results show Democrats making gains and moving closer to securing a majority in the House of Representatives. They have also flipped key Senate seats. If Democrats gain control of Congress, they could increase scrutiny of Trump’s policies and challenge his administration on several fronts. What could this mean for the conflicts involving Iran and Russia-Ukraine, US ties with Israel, and relations with India? Could Trump’s final two years in office become more difficult?
